Carlos Panato

Staff Software Engineer at Chainguard

I work on software supply chain security, cloud native systems and tools that help developers build and ship software with confidence.

I am a Tech Lead for Kubernetes SIG Release, helping the community deliver reliable releases through release engineering and CI/CD. As a long-time open source contributor, I also work across Helm, Sigstore and the broader CNCF and OpenSSF communities, including artifact signing and software supply chain security.

I serve on the OpenSSF Technical Advisory Council and the Continuous Delivery Foundation Technical Oversight Committee . I enjoy collaborating with communities to improve project maintenance, simplify releases and make open source software safer and easier to use.
